title: bindi.immunology_case.v1
description: A synthetic clinical-immunology patient case record. The clinical half (physician) fills it; bindi reads the target from it instead of a fixture. Synthetic patients only (SYNTH- ids). A record is a design target only when signature.signed is true; an unsigned record is a PLACEHOLDER and the design hold stays in force.

case_id.description: Synthetic case id. Must start with SYNTH- so a real patient id cannot be mistaken for one.

presentation.description: Plain-words clinical picture. No free-text identifiers.

hla.description: HLA typing. class_i alleles are what a peptide-MHC design is presented on.

restriction_allele.description: The class I allele the design is restricted to; must appear in class_i.

neoantigen.description: The mutant peptide and its wild-type counterpart. Both are required: the Scientist's condition is that any design is scored against the wild-type complex with a stated margin, not the mutant alone.

source.description: How the variant was called. 'invented' for synthetic cases.

consent.description: What the patient agreed to. A design run is refused unless design_use is true.

design_use.description: Consent covers in-silico design against this patient's variant.

data_class.description: Sensitivity and release class of the record.

synthetic.description: bindi refuses any record not marked synthetic.

signature.description: Clinical sign-off. signed=false means PLACEHOLDER: the design hold stays in force and no real design run may start.
